name: Argentina Time Series API (Series de Tiempo)

provider.name: Argentine Government (Ministerio de Economia, Subsecretaria de Programacion Macroeconomica)

summary: Keyless REST API serving thousands of Argentine official statistical time series (prices, GDP, employment, trade, finance) with on-the-fly transformations.
description: The Series de Tiempo API on apis.datos.gob.ar returns series by id, merged into one table, with frequency conversion (collapse), percent-change and other representation modes, date filtering and JSON or CSV output. A /search endpoint finds series by text, and /dump gives full CSV dumps.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the pages fetched.

endpoints.summary: Values for one or more series ids

license.name: Per series publisher (the sample catalogue states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0)

agent_notes: Find series ids with /search/?q=..., then call /series/?ids=a,b. Rows are arrays [date, value, ...] in the order of the ids; meta[0] describes the table and meta[1..] each series (use metadata=full for licence and source). The parameter last cannot be combined with sort, start or limit. Errors come back as HTTP 400 with an errors array.
caveats: Series ids change if a publisher restructures a dataset; the id in the example is the national CPI (base December 2016).
limit and start paginate rows; the count field is the total number of rows available.
The docs are in Spanish only.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; /search/ also returned 200.
